summary: AI Engineer specializing in Agentic Orchestration (LangGraph, Spring Boot), advanced RAG (hierarchical chunking, document graphs), and production-grade asynchronous backends (Python, Java, RabbitMQ, Kafka, modern vector databases). Proven track record leading cross-functional teams and deploying enterprise conversational systems, real-time multimodal roleplay simulations, and high-precision legal NLP pipelines.

highlights: 2nd Place - UIT Data Science Challenge 2024

roles.title: AI Engineer
highlights: Led a 5-person AI development team, collaborating with PM, PO, and external vendors across iterative delivery cycles to deploy enterprise AI automation systems.
Took end-to-end technical ownership of a production conversational workflow system automating internal workflows and structured ticket orchestration from architecture through cloud deployment.

Architected a multi-layer query routing engine combining LLM reasoning, semantic vector similarity, and deterministic rule matching to bypass redundant generative model invocations and optimize downstream processing.

Architected an asynchronous, message-driven backend with RabbitMQ to decouple external client adapters (e.g., MS Teams) from heavy inference workloads, eliminating synchronous HTTP connection timeouts through instant event acknowledgment and streamed ephemeral status updates.

Solo-designed an agentic orchestration platform in Java (Spring Boot) featuring a declarative dynamic tool-dependency graph that calculates shortest execution paths based on parameter availability, context history, and vector retrieval (Qdrant).
Enforced enterprise-grade reliability using Pydantic validation, structured exception hierarchies, distributed tracing, and centralized logging across Python and Java microservices.

roles.title: AI Engineer Intern
highlights: Spearheaded Legal NLP R&D, designing high-precision RAG pipelines and domain-adapted Named Entity Recognition (NER) models using PyTorch and Hugging Face transformers.

Architected hierarchical document segmentation down to granular statutory units (articles, clauses, sections) using a custom regex engine to extract cross-reference citations and construct interconnected legal document graphs.
Implemented Parent-Document Retrieval paired with hybrid search (lexical + dense) to overcome low semantic contrast and keyword confusion inherent in generalized embedding models on legal corpora.
Addressed acute domain class imbalance via rule-based synonym substitution augmentation, enhancing token-level classification stability on niche legal entities.
Benchmarked embedding architectures and vector representations, evaluating precision, recall, F1, and inference latency tradeoffs to guide production R&D strategy.

projects.name: Dynamic Tool-Orchestration & Graph Execution Platform
highlights: Technologies: Java (Spring Boot), Python, Qdrant, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis
Solo-architected an enterprise agent orchestration engine in Java (Spring Boot) with an admin portal enabling dynamic tool declaration, typed parameter schemas, and input-output aliasing.

Modeled tool dependencies as dynamic directed graphs, computing optimal shortest execution paths (minimizing missing parameters) integrated with conversation history, user profiles, and vector retrieval (Qdrant).
Built a high-throughput event-driven microservices architecture using Spring Boot, Kafka, and Qdrant, accompanied by a lightweight Python service for asynchronous knowledge ingestion.

projects.name: Production Conversational Workflow & Ticket Orchestrator

Led technical development for a production AI conversational engine automating enterprise workflows and internal support ticket routing.
Designed a multi-tier routing pipeline combining deterministic matching, semantic vector search, and LLM reasoning to optimize response latency and token costs.
Decoupled system components with a message-driven RabbitMQ bus, ensuring resilient, non-blocking execution under heavy concurrency.

projects.name: AI Insurance Agent Mentoring Platform
highlights: Technologies: Python, LangGraph, FastAPI, D-ID, Qdrant, LLM-as-a-Judge, Docker
Architected an interactive, real-time video simulation platform enabling insurance agents to practice client consultation through realistic conversational roleplay.
Integrated dynamic conversational state graphs via LangGraph with streaming avatar and synthetic speech services (D-ID), managing bi-directional turn-taking and low-latency interaction.

Implemented an automated evaluation pipeline utilizing LLM-as-a-judge against structured sales rubrics (objection handling, compliance, product knowledge) to deliver granular post-session scorecards and actionable coaching.

projects.name: Multi-Modal Sarcasm Detection & LLM Feature Ablation
highlights: Technologies: Python, PyTorch, ViSoBERT, CafeBERT, Hugging Face
Researched and implemented multi-modal sarcasm detection on Vietnamese social media, achieving 2nd Place in the UIT Data Science Challenge 2024.

Conducted extensive ablation studies on intermediate layer representations across ViSoBERT, CafeBERT, and GPT backbones, discovering that intermediate encoder representations with max pooling capture multi-layered figurative semantics significantly better than vanilla [CLS] token pooling.
